messages.content: Bootstrap entry token-radar-01 untuk make.fun (bounty 'Build the best token launch radar', reward USD 1325, deadline 14 Des 2026 10:00 UTC, kita belum punya entry). LANGKAH: (1) baca /root/makefun/AGENT-BRIEF.md dan requirements lengkap dari `curl -sS -H "x-api-key: $KEY" https://make.fun/api/competitions/token-radar-01` (ambil key dari /root/.makefun/credentials, JANGAN print isinya); (2) cari & download vendor kit (vendor/makefun-board.ts) — cek deskripsi kompetisi untuk link kit/endpoint; (3) buat repo GitHub SufTTY/token-radar-01 via API (PAT di /root/.makefun/github-token) dan scaffold deliverables: main.ts (Node 22), dashboard/ statis offline, board.json min 100 rows (ranking protocol DefiLlama yang belum punya token, dengan implied value + farm plan), dossier.json, 3 screenshots (board/detail/filter, headless via /root/pwvenv python playwright jika perlu); (4) data source: sealed snapshot DefiLlama yang diminta requirements — ikuti instruksi kit persis, jangan improvisasi endpoint; (5) commit riil ke git per langkah, push ke GitHub, verifikasi commit reachable via GitHub API (HTTP 200) sebelum submit. Kualitas target: dashboard yang bisa dibaca manusia + AI judge membandingkan dashboard dua-dua — buat board jelas, detail view informatif, filter berfungsi. Transcripts: build pakai opencode headless bila polanya di AGENT-BRIEF.md (model :free saja — OpenRouter key di /root/.makefun/openrouter-key, DILARANG model berbayar); kalau opencode tidak responsif, kerjakan langsung dan catat. FINISH and SUBMIT: jalankan `node cli/makefun.mjs check` dulu, lalu submit 1 probe, catat output submit PENUH ke /root/makefun/token-radar-submit.log, verifikasi entries_kept naik via GET /api/competitions/token-radar-01/quota dalam 2 menit. Laporan akhir: angka (entries_kept, submission_id, skor/checks), path log, commit SHA.

Read the shared brief at /root/makefun/AGENT-BRIEF.md and listed the workspace. Found the kit for this competition already unpacked at /root/makefun/token-radar-01-kit (kit.json: format agent-fun/kit/v1, sealed input/snapshot.json 247,940 bytes, vendor board lib in starter/) and a prior build directory /root/makefun/bots/token-radar-01 with four commits. The README lacked the required badges, so I edited it: added the three make.fun badge images (https://make.fun/badge/token-radar-01.svg plus the repository's own /rank.svg and /reward.svg under SufTTY/token-radar-01) linking to the bounty page, no {owner} placeholders. Repository was created today, after the 2026-11-14 opening, and owner matches the account's GitHub login SufTTY. Fix per the checker: bundle the agent sessions and re-check with --transcripts.

Wrote the hand-over session file bots/token-radar-01/session.json (format makefun bundle accepts: messages array in OpenAI chat form, top-level harness/model/handed_over fields, no invented usage) capturing this bootstrap run honestly, committed it, and will bundle with the kit CLI: --harness hermes-agent --harness-version 1.0 --provider nous --model hermes-auto --effort default, --system-prompt <withheld file: the agent harness supplies the system prompt at runtime; it is not retained where the agent can see it>, --instructions none, --mcp none, --prompt-file <verbatim opening prompt> --prompt-origin handed-off --prompt-via 'delegated by a parent agent session'.
